# What's working now — aggregate patterns

**The derived scorecard.** Regenerated by `/ps:post-pulse` after each run from the
records in `posts.jsonl`. The raw data is the source of truth; this file is the
cross-post math on top of it, in plain language, so `/ps:post` can draft *strategy*
(which register, which CTA, how long) without recomputing 40 records mid-draft.

This is not `examples.md`. `examples.md` teaches the **shape** of one good post;
this file teaches **what to write and where the skill's own rules disagree with the
data.** Read both before drafting.

> Regenerated 2026-07-17 (pulse: `week` sweep + re-measure pass, first run of the
> updated skill). 40 LinkedIn posts, 0 Twitter/X. Signal strength is noted per
> section; cells with n<4 are directional only, never hard rules.

**Baseline:** median engagement rate **2.14%** (avg 2.19%), across 34 posts with
visible impressions. Field-average engagement (reactions+comments+reposts) is **74**.
Anything above ~2% ER / ~74 eng is pulling its weight.

## Pillar — which register to write in (STRONG signal)

| Pillar                | Avg eng | n  | vs field |
|-----------------------|--------:|---:|----------|
| operators-journal     |   96.1  |  7 | +30% ▲   |
| educational-tactical  |   87.4  |  7 | +18% ▲   |
| industry-take         |   69.5  | 13 | −6%      |
| build-in-public       |   59.0  | 13 | −20% ▼   |

→ **RULE:** Volume is still inverted. 26 of 40 posts are industry-take +
  build-in-public (the two weakest); only 14 are operators-journal +
  educational-tactical (the two strongest). Shift the cadence weighting toward
  operators-journal and educational-tactical. (A newly-logged educational-roadmap
  carousel — 3,256 impressions on first capture — reinforces this: educational
  content is under-published relative to how well it performs.)

## CTA — how to close (STRONG signal)

| CTA                 | Avg eng | n  |
|---------------------|--------:|---:|
| karma-waitlist      |  121.0  |  1 |
| dm-advisory         |  113.8  |  8 |
| github              |   73.0  |  5 |
| (none)              |   67.5  | 14 |
| discord             |   57.0  |  2 |
| engagement-question |   51.7  |  7 |
| newsletter          |   46.0  |  3 |

→ **RULE + CONTRADICTION (held across 2 pulses now):** "DM me" still beats asking a
  question by ~2×, and a bare close (no CTA) still outperforms engagement-question.
  This **contradicts** the post skill's standing instruction to always end with an
  engagement question. Since this pattern has now held across both the 2026-07-11 and
  2026-07-17 pulses, **propose editing `/ps:post` SKILL.md** to stop defaulting to
  engagement-question and instead prefer dm-advisory (Operator's Journal) or a clean
  no-CTA close — pending Pedro's approval.

## Length (MODERATE signal)

| Bucket         | Avg eng | n  |
|----------------|--------:|---:|
| <400 chars     |   80.4  |  8 |
| 400–800 chars  |   80.9  | 17 |
| 800–1300 chars |   62.5  | 15 |

→ **RULE:** Short and medium posts (under ~800 chars) still clearly beat long ones.
  Don't pad past ~800 chars without a reason. (Rubs against the skill's "700–1,500
  typical" LinkedIn default — same contradiction as last pulse, not yet actioned.)

## Day of week (WEAK signal — small cells, do NOT hard-gate)

Best: Thu (121, n2), Sun (96, n7), Wed (98, n2). Worst: Tue (47, n5).
Friday averages 59 yet is still the **most-used day (13 posts)**.

→ **WATCH:** Still no strong enough signal to force a day change. Sunday (n=7) is the
  most-supported alternative to Friday so far.

## Outliers worth studying

- **Correction from the re-measure pass:** the previous "highest ER ever" reading
  (`ln-2026-06-22`, 14.2% on 253 impressions) was an artifact of an early, partial
  impression count caught right after posting. With a fuller reading (1,588
  impressions, 18 days later) its real ER is **2.4%** — a normal industry-take post,
  not an outlier. **This is why the re-measure pass exists**: single-snapshot posts
  can be badly misleading until impressions settle.
- **Highest ER now:** `ln-2026-05-29-vertical-voice-ai-niche`, **3.8%** (78 eng /
  2,031 imp). "Most founders chase the biggest market... I went the other way."
  Operators-journal, niche-bet framing.
- **Highest reach/eng ever:** `ln-2026-01-29` "New adventure. 🚀", 227 eng / 8,817
  imp. Three-word opener + pivot announcement + dm-advisory.
- **New exemplar discovered this pulse:** an 8-page "How to Start in Voice AI"
  roadmap carousel (educational-tactical, `educational-roadmap` hook) cleared 3,256
  impressions on first capture — crossed the exemplar bar immediately. Educational
  carousels are underused relative to how they perform; see the pillar rule above.

## Open questions for the next pulse (data gaps)

- **`top_comments` is still nearly empty.** This pulse prioritized the re-measure
  pass (correcting stale/misleading snapshots) over comment capture; qualitative
  signal is deferred to the next run.
- **Growth curves have started:** 18/40 posts now have a 2nd snapshot (up from 1/39
  last pulse). Not yet enough same-post history to say which hooks peak fast vs.
  slow, but the mechanism is working.
- **One post spotted but not fully captured:** a QCobro "Six months ago, I stopped
  everything" collections-in-autopilot carousel (~2026-05-17). Needs a follow-up
  capture next pulse.
- **No Twitter/X data.** All patterns above are LinkedIn-only.

---

### How this file is regenerated

`/ps:post-pulse` recomputes this after each sweep from `posts.jsonl`: averages by
pillar / CTA / length / day-of-week, the ER baseline, the current outliers, and any
place a data pattern contradicts a rule in `/ps:post` (surface those explicitly — they
are the highest-value output; if a contradiction holds across ≥2 pulses, propose the
rule edit for Pedro's approval). Keep it short (~1 screen); it is a summary, not an
archive. Treat every cell with n<4 as directional.
